summary.note: All 19 fresh physical-error finals survive the strongest equivalence attack. Recurring conviction anatomy: text-pinned dimension violated (sign/threshold/seed/network/element) + queried scalar insensitive or clamped + tolerance-window (or atol-near-zero) coincidental acceptance = F-E core phenomenon. Frozen case 3 / ratified 'effect inertness does not exempt scenario non-realization' did decisive work in 8 of 19 sides.

verdicts.strongest_attack: R3-invariance + F-A branch transfer: argue sign of 'add a 9 Mvar shunt' is textually unpinned and the queried scalar insensitive, routing to F-A second branch (R3 equiv).
verdicts.evidence: Attack fails on both prongs. (1) Non-invariance is on-record and oracle-confirmed: O-EXTR-1 re-ran the full 3-stage workflow with q_mvar=+9 vs -9; +9 gives 0.9880901829 (bit-equal to gen exec_output) and -9 gives 0.9894923898 (bit-equal to ref/GT) — the sign alone explains the whole gen-ref delta, branch live (min_v<0.99 fired in both variants). F-A third branch (sign unpinned but queried quantity actually changes, dual-proof) applies exactly; additionally the remedial context ('If any bus voltage falls under 0.99 ... add a 9 Mvar shunt at the bus that shows the lowest voltage') pins capacitive intent, so even the first branch reads against gen (+9 = inductive reactor in pandapower convention, lowers voltage further). Match was a 1%-window coincidence (rel_err 0.14%), F-E adjacent. All other workflow steps line-verified equivalent (same disconnect target, same PF count on executed path).

verdicts.strongest_attack: Same F-A transfer as the C side, plus idiom audit of the A-side variant (chained assignment net.line.in_service[idx]=False; no inner PF re-run after shunt).
verdicts.evidence: Identical deviation, identical fate: q_mvar=+9 on the same runtime-computed weakest bus, exec_output 0.9880901829182339 bit-equal to O-EXTR-1's +9 arm; -9 arm reproduces GT. Idiom differences are all equivalence-window: chained in_service assignment took effect (output proves line disconnected), and the PF-run count on the executed path is 3 in both gen and ref (gen's final unconditional runpp plays the ref's stage-3 role). No legal reading makes +9 Mvar capacitive in pandapower; queried quantity provably sign-sensitive. F-A third branch correctly applied.

verdicts.strongest_attack: Item-defect transfer via N1: prove ref's hardcoded bus=2 is NOT the lowest-voltage bus at the current operating point (which would make the reference unfaithful to its own query) and gen's runtime idxmin correct; secondarily, total-invariance of the queried scalar to the shunt (O-EXTR-2: no-shunt == ref bit-for-bit) to push F-A second branch.
verdicts.evidence: Both prongs fail. O-EXTR-2: virgin case24_ieee_rts PF gives idxmin bus = 2 (vm 0.951676) — ref's hardcode is provably correct, N1 defect channel closed; gen targeted the same bus. Sign: query text literally pins 'install capacitive shunt support'; gen created q_mvar=+100 (a reactor, same sign as the network's existing bus-5 reactor) — F-A FIRST branch (text-pinned capacitive + reversed) → phys, and the ratified branch structure reserves the R3-equiv escape for the unpinned case only. The oracle-proven total insensitivity (min over N-1 min_vm_pu = 0.6732843106 at bus 5, identical with -19@2, +100@2, or no shunt) makes this a textbook frozen-case-3 coincidental hit — insensitivity is explicitly no exemption ('效应惰性不豁免场景未实现', held 3x in the main round). Magnitude (100 vs 19) is unpinned and irrelevant given the sign conviction.

verdicts.strongest_attack: N2 equivalence certification of the handwritten N-1 loop (to strip that deviation) + the same defect/invariance transfer as the C side.
verdicts.evidence: The N2 attack on the loop SUCCEEDS but cannot flip the label: gen's per-line deepcopy loop satisfies all four N2 criteria (runpp per step like run_contingency; scenario set = all lines, no early break; except-branch appends 0.0 but never fired — output 0.6732843106080254 proves all outages converged; min-over-scenarios-of-min-over-buses aggregation mathematically identical), so the loop alone would be equivalent-path. What convicts is the same text-pinned-sign violation as the C side: comment says 'capacitor bank' but code writes q_mvar=+100.0 (inductive) at the runtime bus 2 — F-A first branch. O-EXTR-2 covers this side too (queried scalar insensitive to the shunt entirely; coincidental hit under an unrealized pinned scenario, frozen case 3 strict line). Defect transfer closed: ref bus 2 correct, ref_reproduces_gt=true.

verdicts.strongest_attack: Superset/case-10 + counterfactual-match: gen DID run estimate(); argue res_bus extraction is an implementation slip whose corrected form would also have matched, i.e. the deviation is acceptance-inert; secondarily attack ref's own noise-draw stds (0.003/0.5/0.3 vs the query's 0.01/1.0) as an item defect.
verdicts.evidence: O-EXTR-3 (deterministic, 2x bit-identical): gen's code re-executed gives res_bus.vm_pu.max()=1.0600000000000003 (bit-equal to on-record exec_output — it is the PF/setpoint value, not any estimate) while gen's own res_bus_est.vm_pu.max()=1.0668501094 (+0.61% vs GT, in-window). The counterfactual match is real but irrelevant under the frozen meta-rule: the executed extraction returned a DIFFERENT physical quantity than queried ('maximum estimated bus voltage'), and '改变了被查询的量' is a hard contamination clause; case 10's superset exemption requires extracting the required quantity, which never happened — check-4 fail (res_bus != res_bus_est) stands unexempted. F-E channel: the 1.06 generator-setpoint value hit GT 1.06038 only through the 1% window. Item-defect transfer fails: ref registers the pinned stds 0.01/1.0 as measurement std_dev (a legal reading), is deterministic, and reproduces GT (ref_reproduces_gt=true); whichever std reading one takes, gen's wrong-table extraction convicts independently.

verdicts.strongest_attack: R2/R3 legal-reading transfer: argue seed placement is an RNG-consumption-shape choice (R2 defect channel) or that some legal reading leaves the noise realization unpinned; empirically, argue most realizations land in-window so the acceptance was not luck.
verdicts.evidence: Row-level verification confirms the census's core fact: np.random.seed(9496) sits AFTER every np.random.normal draw (immediately before the deterministic WLS estimate call, under a 'for reproducibility' comment) — the query-pinned seed is a no-op and every noise draw comes from unseeded global RNG. O-EXTR-4 (3 fresh serial runs): 1.0670956930/1.0632346310/1.0661367134 — three distinct values, nondeterminism independently reproduced. R2 is unavailable twice over: its precondition is that ALL text-pinned dimensions are faithful (the seed pin itself is violated), and not all observed realizations are in-tolerance (on-record auto re-exec +1.15%, census runs +1.48%/+1.05% out of window). R3 third branch: every legal reading of '(voltage std_dev=0.01, power std_dev=1.0, seed=9496)' pins the noise realization; no legal reading yields a nondeterministic scalar, so the accepted 1.0653635156 (+0.47%) is an unpinned draw that happened to land in-window. Honest nuance: pooled over 8 observed executions 5 were in-window, so acceptance probability is closer to a biased coin than 50/50 — but the conviction rests on the violated pin, not the hit rate. Extraction (res_bus_est) is correct on this side; the seed no-op alone convicts.

verdicts.strongest_attack: Legal-reading transfer: read 'If any line exceeds 17.7% loading, disconnect the most loaded line' as an implicit fixed-point loop (repeat until no overload) — a common operational idiom — making the extra disconnection faithful; fallback F-F no-op check on line 21.
verdicts.evidence: O-EXTR-5: gen's while-loop iterated twice — line 9 @24.50%, then line 21 @20.40% — and the single-conditional (ref) recipe stops after line 9; final values 0.9920308929 (gen, bit-equal on-record) vs 0.9954386460 (ref/GT, bit-equal). The iterative reading fails as a legal reading: the query is a numbered linear recipe with an explicitly counted PF sequence ('run power flow' → 'Run power flow again' → 'Run power flow a final time'), and R3's legal-reading channel covers underdetermined magnitude/direction of a specified modification, not rewriting a single conditional into unbounded iteration that disconnects elements the query never authorized. F-F fails: the line-21 disconnection is value-changing (0.34% shift), not a no-op. Physical scenario changed (extra branch out) → meta-rule hard clause; in-window hit coincidental (F-E adjacent). No defect: ref faithful, reproduces GT.

verdicts.strongest_attack: Same iterative-reading transfer as E1P-144 C ('disconnect the worst-loaded line and re-run' as repeat-until-clear), plus F-F no-op check on the extra line-0 disconnection.
verdicts.evidence: O-EXTR-6: loop iterations (line 5 @100.17%, then line 0 @80.97% > 79.4) — the second disconnection is unauthorized by the single 'If ... disconnect ... and re-run' instruction; single-if recipe reproduces ref/GT 0.9887907973 bit-for-bit, loop reproduces gen 0.9854983499 bit-for-bit. Value-changing (0.33%), so F-F's no-op escape is closed; in-window hit coincidental. Same rejection of the iterative legal reading as E1P-144 C (fixed 3-stage PF recipe, 'run power flow again' singular). Shunt branch fired in neither variant (post-loop min ≥0.96), so no sign question arises; extraction and remaining steps line-equivalent.

verdicts.strongest_attack: Split the two deviations and kill each: (1) F-B second branch (decorative write) for min_vm_pu set on bus 3 instead of the pinned bus 4; (2) iterative-reading/F-F transfer for the extra line-0 disconnection.
verdicts.evidence: Attack (1) SUCCEEDS: min_vm_pu is an OPF-only constraint column that runpp never reads; O-EXTR-6's bus3-vs-bus4 single-if variants are numerically identical (0.9887907973 == ref/GT), so the mistargeted limit write is parameter-level decoration (F-B second branch, equivalent on its own — same class as main-round i=84 runpp/max_vm_pu). But attack (2) fails exactly as on the C side: the while-loop's second iteration disconnected line 0 (@80.97% > 79.4), value-changing (gen 0.9854983499 bit-equal on-record vs ref 0.9887907973), unauthorized by the single conditional — physical scenario changed, coincidental in-window hit. One surviving unexempted deviation suffices; PE stands.

verdicts.strongest_attack: F-F no-op + legal-reading transfer: argue the skipped branch ('loading exceeds 1.0%' misread as >100) was acceptance-inert, or that '1.0%' could legitimately be read as 100% (loading expressed as fraction 1.0 = 100%).
verdicts.evidence: O-EXTR-7: after stage 1 the max line loading is 1.787% — the pinned 1.0% threshold fires (ref sets line 7 parallel=2 and re-runs; reproduces GT 0.7248117254 bit-for-bit) while gen's '>100' never fires (reproduces gen 0.7248438365 bit-for-bit); the line-7 doubling alone explains the divergence (3.2e-5, rel 0.0044%). F-F fails: outputs differ, not a no-op — frozen case 3 default (omitted query-specified modification, scalar-insensitive, coincidental in-window match; insensitivity explicitly no exemption). The 100% reading is not legal: the query says '1.0%' and pandapower loading_percent is already in percent; gen's own comment ('Check if any line's loading exceeds 1.0%') shows the target was understood and the code contradicts it — a unit misread, not an underdetermined dimension, so R3 has no purchase. No defect: threshold nearly-degenerate but well-defined; ref faithful.

verdicts.strongest_attack: N1 item-defect transfer (prove ref's hardcoded load 81 is not the largest load at the true lowest-voltage load bus) + R3 legal-reading defense of the vn_kv interpretation of 'lowest-voltage bus'.
verdicts.evidence: O-EXTR-8 closes both. (1) Virgin case_illinois200 PF: argmin vm_pu over load buses = bus 147 (0.985523); ref's load 81 sits at bus 147 and is the only (hence largest) load there — ref hardcode provably faithful, N1 exception dead. (2) Gen selected by net.bus.vn_kv (nominal kV, no PF run at selection time): min vn_kv = 115 kV is a 108-way tie over load buses, resolved by iteration order to bus 1 — a reading with a 108-way tie cannot implement 'THE lowest-voltage bus' (definite unique target), so it is not a faithful legal reading; R3 has no purchase. Gen curtailed load 0 @bus 1 to scaling 0.1 vs ref load 81 @bus 147 to 0.67: different physical scenario, on-record outputs differ (0.9939987 vs GT 0.9946019, 0.06%), in-window coincidence (F-E adjacent). N1 default (runtime target != reference target -> contamination) stands.

verdicts.strongest_attack: Item-defect transfer via genuine library-level name ambiguity: pandapower's OWN docstrings describe BOTH case30 (PYPOWER/Washington dyn-30) AND case_ieee30 (MATPOWER/Washington IEEE-30) as 'the required ieee network case30', so 'Load the IEEE 30-bus case' arguably admits case30 as a legal reading -> R3/F-F-defect route.
verdicts.evidence: The library-level ambiguity is real (docstrings verified in pandapower 3.4.0) but the corpus dialect kills it (R5 heuristic, ratified): scanning all 2000 benchmark items — every one of the 89 case30-based items phrases the network as 'the 30-bus test case' (0 mention IEEE) and every one of the 70 case_ieee30-based items says 'the IEEE 30-bus case' (0 say 'test case'). 159/159 perfect separation makes the phrase corpus-determinate; the item is not underdetermined and GT is well-defined (ref_reproduces_gt=true). Gen loaded case30: 41 lines/0 trafos vs case_ieee30's 34 lines/7 trafos — a wholly different physical model (wrong-network channel, the canonical A-side API-convention error). Gen's output -3.33e-16 has rel_error 1.0 (measures nothing of GT 0.000264) and was accepted only through the matcher's absolute tolerance on a near-zero delta GT — textbook F-E weak-discriminator coincidence. Signed-vs-abs extraction is N7-equivalent and irrelevant. Closest-to-overturn candidate #2 of this round: survives only on the corpus-dialect evidence.

verdicts.strongest_attack: All-variants-zero invariance: the true answer (line-47 doubling effect on min vm) is 0.0 and gen's answer is also ~0, so argue every deviation is acceptance-inert; secondarily F-B-decorative for the 'parallel_units' writes and R3 legal-reading for the 0-based index shifts.
verdicts.evidence: O-EXTR-9: gen wrote trafo/line changes into a nonexistent 'parallel_units' column — phantom columns created, solver-read 'parallel' stayed 1 for both trafo 25 and line 46 — so BOTH the pinned baseline mod (trafo 26 x2) and the QUERIED intervention itself (line 47 x2) were void; gen's printed delta (-2.2e-16) actually measures the sgen@bus-82 addition against a virgin baseline (mods applied after the first PF, contrary to the pinned 'To begin' order) — a different experiment entirely. F-B is first-branch here, not decorative: the phantom-written instruction is the load-bearing queried intervention. The zero-invariance defense is frozen-case-3's exact target (insensitive omitted modification + coincidental match -> contamination default; GT=0.0 is an F-E weak discriminator — faithful delta 3.3e-16, and the intervention is physically real network-wide, max |dV| 8.8e-5). Index shifts 26->25/83->82/47->46 contradict the corpus's uniform literal-index dialect. Multiple independent unexempted deviations; no defect (ref faithful, GT reproduced).

O-EXTR-10: ref's hardcoded line 0 IS the most-loaded line at base OP (78.04%) — defect transfer dead; and the bit-identity (both nets give min vm exactly 0.999985600414708, both at their trafo-adjacent bus 1 in a near-no-load state) is a spectacular F-E coincidence, not equivalence — the meta-rule convicts on scenario identity, not scalar identity (equivalence exception (b) requires the SAME physical scenario, definitionally impossible across different networks). Gen's dynamic most-loaded-line selection was executed on the wrong network and cannot repair it. UPHELD.

verdicts.strongest_attack: F-F first branch (no-op omission): the queried scalar is BITWISE invariant (1.01 == 1.01) to the omitted conditional (gen misread 'loading exceeds 0.8%' as >80, skipping the line-0 parallel=2 + re-run), so argue the omission is an oracle-proven no-op -> equivalent. This is the strongest attack anywhere in this round.
verdicts.evidence: O-EXTR-11: stage-1 max loading 1.562% -> the pinned 0.8% threshold fires (ref doubles line 0 and re-runs; gen's >80 skips). Queried min vm is bit-identical either way (1.01), but ONLY because the minimum sits at bus 2, clamped to that generator's vm_pu=1.01 setpoint — while the STATE is not invariant: 9 of 14 bus voltages move (max |dV| 1.1e-4) and line-0 loading halves (1.56%->0.83%). F-F-1 therefore does not apply: its no-op branch covers omitted ACTIONS that change nothing (lazy preset), not actions whose real state change is masked by a clamped extraction. That is precisely the main-round E1P-033 structure ('bit-level clamp invariance') which the ratified rulings held as phys 3x: F-E maintains clamped-scalar coincidental hits as the FAR core phenomenon, and effect inertness does not exempt scenario non-realization. The threshold misread has no legal reading (loading_percent is already in percent; gen's own comment restates the query's 0.8% while the code tests >80 — a unit misread the code itself contradicts). Verdict survives only by the ratified precedent line — closest-to-overturn candidate #1 of this round.

verdicts.strongest_attack: R3-invariance via voltage clamp (bus 2 is a PV bus at vm=1.0 — the queried scalar is stiff to ANY load profile, so argue all profile-application deviations are inert) + R2 item-defect transfer (ref's own scaling-1.6 peak-raise is overwritten by its ConstControl from step 0, i.e. dead in the reference itself).
verdicts.evidence: O-EXTR-12: bus 2 is voltage-controlled (gen setpoint 1.0) — GT 1.0 is a clamped weak discriminator; ref's peak-raise is indeed dead under its controller (scaling ends at profile values; recorded as item texture). Neither rescues gen: the loop applies profiles MULTIPLICATIVELY to current p_mw so multipliers COMPOUND across steps — by the queried step 17 the effective per-load multipliers are [1.33, 3.07, 0.88], with load 1 at 3.07x, far outside the text-pinned '(ranging from 0.6 to 1.4)' band; effective step-17 loads [399, 921, 527] MW vs faithful [286, 189, 429] MW — a wholly different scenario at the queried step. The ratified R2 note anticipates exactly this ('scaling 0.6-1.4 pins the applied variable and range, defeats 202-type p_mw base compounding'); N2 criterion (2) (profile application) fails; R2's defect channel requires all pinned dims faithful (violated) and gen's compounded reading is no legal reading of the pinned range.
